newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Wednesday as dealers continued to cover their needs ahead of the long U.S. Memorial day weekend.
"This is a holiday market," a Buffalo dealer said. "That would mean reduced runtimes. We will see a cutback in demand as we get into June, but not right now."
He said he expected prices to trend lower in June.
"Already we see offers discounted about $10 (a ton) for the first week or so in June compared to next week's delivery," he said. "Once we get by the holiday, things will be quiet," the dealer added.
A North Carolina dealer said feed mixers have already covered their needs but merchandisers were trying to buy what supply was left to take care of the sales they have made.
Nearby supplies were also scant in other areas of the southeast.
"There is no feed around here for the next week or two," a Chattanooga dealer said. "If you need to buy something here you are in deep trouble."
But a St Louis broker said the spurt in nearby demand was exaggerated due to a thin market.
